verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close uses AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies during month-end close, which covers the core idea of an agent flagging issues before the close. The Puzzle MCP also lets an external agent like Claude query the financial data. However, nothing documents dedicated spend-anomaly or duplicate-transaction detection, or ongoing monitoring outside the close workflow. Missing for 10: explicit duplicate-transaction detection, spend anomaly flagging, continuous/proactive ledger monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
